distribution.description: Linux distribution to build in (e.g., debian:bullseye, ubuntu:jammy)

container_command.description: Container command to use (podman or docker)

build_dirs_path.description: Path for writing build files and artifacts (defaults to parent directory if omitted)

host_architecture.description: Host architecture for cross builds (e.g., amd64, arm64, armhf)

skip_sources.description: Skip source tarball creation to speed up builds (build mode only)

with_binaries.description: Include binaries in release (e.g., for NEW upload)

pull.description: Force update of container base image before build

copy.description: Build inside a copy of the source directory

clean.description: Ensure clean sources before and after build
